verdict.rationale: Sentry's official docs describe dropping in SDKs across a broad platform matrix ('If you use it, we probably support it') covering web, backend, and mobile, with core automatic error-capture as the platform's primary value prop, corroborated by community praise for deep integration. Missing for 10: explicit hands-on confirmation of automatic uncaught-exception capture per specific SDK (e.g., iOS/Android auto-instrumentation details) and independent benchmarking of capture completeness.
